Furthermore, ARPO incorporates advantage attribution estimation, which enables the model to better understand the effectiveness of different tool-use interactions by attributing the advantage to specific actions. This is achieved by calculating the difference between the Q-value of a specific action and the average Q-value of the policy, allowing the model to learn which actions are most beneficial in a given context.
